title: Syringe (+1)

sources.title: Inject Nostrum
markers: | description = Inject an enemy with the mysterious liquid in your syringe and possibly {{SmCond|Poisoned|Poison}} them.

summary: Syringe has a separate undead nurse damage rule.

fields.Weapon profile: Simple, One-handed, 5 ft melee, Finesse, Light, Thrown. 1d4 + 1 Piercing plus Strength or Dexterity. +1 to attack rolls.
fields.Nurse-only effect: An undead nurse wielding it deals an additional 1d6 Necrotic.
fields.Acquisition: Carried by Sister Anya in the House of Healing.
fields.Inject Nostrum: NPC-only Action once per Short Rest. Weapon damage plus proficiency Piercing and 1d6 Necrotic. Dexterity save against weapon-action DC +2 or Poisoned for 2 turns. No weapon actions are available to a player who equips this syringe.
fields.Inspiration: Collect one of each nurse’s tool to earn Right Tool for the Job for Criminal characters.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
